title: DisabledEnd
body:
DisabledEnd lets a server operator lock players out of the End using three independent methods you can toggle in-game at any time. No config files, no restarts, no client mod required.

## Commands (requires op permission)
- **/end on   /end off**	Master switch. off = normal End; on = methods below apply.
- **/end no-collision enable|disable**	Entities pass through the End portal instead of teleporting.
- **/end missing-portal enable|disable**	Stronghold portals spawn with 1–3 frames missing.
- **/end no-structure enable|disable**	Removes strongholds and restores natural terrain.
- **/end status**	Show current settings.
